messages:
maya-cs: Heads-up — Lodestar reserved pool warmup tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need quota priming, autoscale policy sanity check, and loadtest script handoff. @tom-eng @raj-sre @shelly-ops can you confirm who owns the dry-run? :calendar:

 tom-eng: I can own the dry-run. Plan: steady 50 r/s for 30m then ramp to 250 r/s over 10m. We'll run shadow traffic first, then cut to dedicated. Any SLA thresholds we must not cross?

 maya-cs: SLA target is p99 < 1200ms. Abort if p99 > 2s for >5m. Kevin, can you approve up to 10% error budget usage for the warmup?

 kevin-lodestar: Approved up to 8% error budget for warmup only, not for prod. We'll be watching token spend too.

 raj-sre: For autoscale, propose policy: min=2, target_cpu=65, max=20, scale_cooldown=120s. Also add +2 replica headroom for first 15m. Pasting config snippet below.

 raj-sre: ```json
{"autoscale": {"min_replicas": 2, "max_replicas": 20, "target_cpu": 65, "scale_cooldown": 120, "initial_headroom": 2, "headroom_duration_s": 900}}
```

 tom-eng: We'll enable prefix cache priming for top-10 prompts — reduces kv cache cold misses. Config: `cache.prefix=true` and pre-seed keys via the priming job.

 shelly-ops: I'll run the load script and hand off to CI. Local test command: `./scripts/lode_load.sh --rps 50 --duration 1800 --model rdx-gpt-13b-qa-quant`

 tom-eng: Note: use model variant `rdx-gpt-13b-qa-quant` to match prod latency profile. Do NOT switch model variants mid-warmup.

 maya-cs: Ops checklist before 09:00 PT:
- quota bump verified with billing
- KMS keys in place
- notify SRE oncall
- pre-warm prefix cache
- smoke test (single req)
Can people ack when items are done?

 deploy-bot: Scheduled job created: `warmup-lodestar-1719900000`. Will post status updates here.

 raj-sre: ack for SRE. I'll be oncall desk 08:45-10:30 PT and will abort if error rate > 5% for 3 consecutive minutes or p99 > 2s sustained for 5 minutes.

 kevin-lodestar: Adding our monitoring dashboard: https://dash.lodestar.example/reds/123 — we'll watch errors, p99, token consumption, and 429s. Also please restrict test traffic to our account only.

 maya-cs: Great. Tom / Shelly — paste the runbook and logs after the run. Quick RC scheduled for 10:30 PT to review metrics and sign-off.

 tom-eng: Will post loadtest summary after completion. Example expected output snippet post-run:
```
requests: 450k
p50: 120ms
p90: 340ms
p99: 980ms
errors: 0.6%
replicas_peak: 12
CPU_avg: 58%
```

 shelly-ops: CI job queued: `ci/warmup-lodestar.yaml`. I'll ping here when it's running and again when finished.

 kevin-lodestar: One ask from Lodestar: do not change model versions or tokenization settings during warmup. We'll validate semantic quality after metrics look good.

 maya-cs: Noted. Thanks everyone — feel free to drop short updates here (small messages preferred). :thumbsup:
